about.title: About Us
about.intro: Founded in 2010, El Basha for General Supplies & Contracting delivers road and infrastructure works, bridges and axes, development and maintenance projects, and brick factory construction, alongside the supply of construction materials. The company operates its own fleet of heavy equipment and executes projects across all governorates of Egypt.
